0.name: Front Desk
0.blurb: Where every book comes home. Stamp it, shelve it, and learn the rhythm of the day.

1.name: Returns Desk
1.blurb: Trays of numbers arrive by the cartload. Arrays are simply tidy carts.

2.name: The Stacks
2.blurb: Long rows of shelves and longer tables. Choose columns, keep rows, sort the lot.

3.name: Display Hall
3.blurb: Everything under glass. Bars, bins and scatter on the polished floor.

4.name: Catalogue Room
4.blurb: Cabinets of cards. Write a function, group the drawers, pivot the counts.

5.name: Loans Office
5.blurb: Two ledgers, one gold thread. Join them and see who borrowed what.

6.name: Sealed Archive
6.blurb: Sampling by lamplight. Take a handful of cards and reason about the whole drawer.

7.name: Trustees’ Hall
7.blurb: Claims, shuffles and shaded tails. Test a story until it confesses.

8.name: Bookends Gallery
8.blurb: Resampling from end to end. Bootstrap an interval and hang it on the wall.

9.name: Almanac Tower
9.blurb: Centre, spread and the standard units that make two shelves comparable.

10.name: Reading Room
10.blurb: Correlation and the quiet line that fits a cloud of borrowings.

11.name: Unlabelled Stacks
11.blurb: Nearest neighbours in a stretched room. Guess the label, then measure the misses.

12.name: The Last Card
12.blurb: Priors, evidence and a branching chute. Update a belief with counts.

13.name: Grand Reopening
13.blurb: The doors open again. Answer the closing requests and the library is yours.

script-slot.title: A second writing desk
script-slot.description: Six more script slots, so helper modules get their own page instead of crowding main.py.

replay-speed.title: Well-oiled cart wheels
replay-speed.description: Raises the replay dial from 2× to 8× for long traces.

standing-slot.title: A second order peg
standing-slot.description: Hang a second standing order on the wall and both keep earning.

standing-slot-3.title: A third order peg
standing-slot-3.description: One more peg, for three standing orders at once.

ink-ledger.title: A tidier ledger
ink-ledger.description: Neat columns pay better: every patron served brings a quarter more Ink.

oil-flask.title: A flask of lamp oil
oil-flask.description: Twenty measures of Lamp Oil for archive sampling. Buy as many as you like.

hat-reading-cap.title: Reading cap
hat-reading-cap.description: Shelby reads a little faster: ten percent more Ink per patron. Wear it or hang it back up.

hat-beret.title: Beret
hat-beret.description: An artistic temperament forgives one hint, so a single nudge still earns the clean-solve star.

hat-graduation.title: Graduation cap
hat-graduation.description: Scholarly posture: one extra Gold Star for every request completed while it is worn.

hat-lantern.title: Lantern hat
hat-lantern.description: Hands-free light halves the Lamp Oil an archive sampling trip burns.

hat-beanie.title: Knit beanie
hat-beanie.description: Warm ears, brisk pace: standing-order trips run fifteen percent faster.

hatchling.title: Hatch a helper
hatchling.description: A young turtle joins the cart. Each helper adds a full round of standing-order trips.
